When a customer reports missing or weak citations for scanned PDFs, support should follow these diagnostic and resolution steps:

1. **Verify upload and OCR status** – Check the upload metadata to confirm the file is flagged as an image-only PDF, and ensure the customer's workspace has OCR enabled [NL-006#NL-006-S03]. If OCR is disabled or not run, the parser extracts zero text and citations cannot be generated [NL-006#NL-006-S03].

2. **Inspect the scanned document quality** – Advise the customer to review the original scan. Blurry, low-resolution, handwritten, or complex-layout scans cause OCR errors that break citations [NL-006#NL-006-S03]. If possible, instruct them to export the document from the source system as a digital, text-searchable PDF instead of scanning a printed sheet [NL-006#NL-006-S03].

3. **If scanning is unavoidable, recommend the Advanced OCR Pipeline** – This is available to Enterprise customers or as a Growth add-on and uses layout-aware vision models to better reconstruct text [NL-006#NL-006-S03].

4. **Check admin and OCR logs** – Inspect the admin logs for the query to identify the retrieved source ID and section ID [NL-006#NL-006-S04]. If the source is a scanned PDF, review the OCR logs specifically to see whether page boundaries were missed during indexing [NL-006#NL-006-S04].

5. **Check document status and permissions** – Confirm the document is marked as "current" and not "deprecated" or "stale," and that the user has permission to view the folder; otherwise update the document, adjust grounding preferences, or grant access [NL-006#NL-006-S04] [NL-028#NL-028-S03].

6. **If OCR completed with errors, recommend re-uploading or re-saving as a digital file** – The troubleshooting guide directs checking whether OCR completed without errors; if not, the scan quality should be improved or the file re-saved in a text-searchable format [NL-028#NL-028-S03]. Also remind that low-quality scanned PDFs may not generate page-specific citations, so re-exporting as digital text is the preferred fix [NL-028#NL-028-S03].

These steps directly address missing or weak citations caused by scanned, image-only PDFs by confirming OCR enablement, improving source quality, and verifying indexing and permissions.
